attribution: Alan Leo, The Progressed Horoscope (1906), Ch. XVI (Directions to MC/Ascendant)

angle_function.Ascendant: Directions to the Ascendant primarily affect general health and may also produce mental disturbances.
angle_function.Midheaven: Directions to the Midheaven primarily affect honour, employment, reputation and parents.

engineRules.timing_sensitivity: Leo states that an error of four minutes in birth time corresponds to about one year of error in directions to the angles, whether Primary or Secondary.
engineRules.rectification_note: Leo explicitly presents directions of the Ascendant to Saturn or Mars as potentially useful in birth-time rectification.
engineRules.natal_condition_modifier: The natal condition of the planet must modify the delineation. An afflicted benefic may yield comparatively little good under a favourable direction, while a dignified and well-aspected malefic may produce comparatively little evil.
engineRules.grouped_aspect_rule: Where Leo groups multiple aspect geometries under one numbered delineation, apply the record only when Orbo calculates one of the explicitly listed geometries.
engineRules.neptune_conjunction_rule: For records 373, 391 and 400 Leo states that the conjunction is doubtful in effect; it is therefore not included as a matching geometry.
